title: National Backward Classes Finance and Development Corporation (NBCFDC) — Individual Loan Scheme
sourceDescription: NBCFDC official website, 'Individual Loan Scheme' page. Fetched live and transcribed for this corpus.

sections.text: Applicants must be members of Backward Classes, as notified by the Central Government or State Governments from time to time.
The applicant's annual family income should be up to Rs. 5.00 lakh.
The maximum loan limit is Rs. 25.00 lakh per beneficiary. NBCFDC provides 85% of the funds through the Channel Partner; the beneficiary (with the Channel Partner) contributes the remaining 15%.

For income-generating activities up to Rs. 1.25 lakh: NBCFDC lends to the Channel Partner at 4% p.a., the Channel Partner lends to the beneficiary at 7% p.a., with a 4-year repayment period. For income-generating activities between Rs. 1.25 lakh and Rs. 25 lakh: NBCFDC lends at 5% p.a., the beneficiary rate is 8% p.a., with a 7-year repayment period. For education loans up to Rs. 25 lakh: NBCFDC lends at 5% p.a., the beneficiary rate is 8% p.a., with a maximum 10-year term inclusive of a 5-year moratorium period.
